facts: The registered property is the Brooks Catsup Bottle Water Tower at 800 Morrison Avenue in Collinsville. It was listed in 2002.
The tower is 170 feet tall. The 70-foot riveted tank sits above 100-foot steel supports. The bottle base is 25 feet across and the cap is 8 feet across. Restoration was completed in June 1995.
The W. E. Caldwell Company built the bottle in 1949 for the G. S. Suppiger Catsup Bottling Plant.
